method: Learn conditional forecast-error evolution on completed non-events; use observed pre-actuation[-15,0) residuals to track nuisance at retrospective feature extraction. Prior notice-time prediction and raw energy remain unchanged.
short_candidate: Preserve original-CPOP <=60s positive support while using tracked-reference duration features elsewhere; no binary task veto or point deletion.
comparison: Full factorial tracking/no tracking x original CPOP/LABS/retained duration_fusion. Formal same-condition controls receive exactly the same tracked residual/reference and meter. Dual-short candidate additionally combines old/tracked structural support, with both source fits retained.
evaluation: All cases scored, cumulative and longest MAE equally weighted, conditions equal; positive/negative/short counts and paired-seed differences reported. No test tuning.
scope: Native1min controlled EV task, starts0/ends30min,q1.5,declared noise.05,pre/post15min, instructed actuation does not begin before0. This process nuisance tracking is NOT an updated reference available at notice; it never uses task-period or rebound measurements to fit nuisance.
